meta.provider: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Waterborne Commerce Statistics Center; distributed in the USDOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD)
meta.layerDescription: The principal port file contains USACE port codes, geographic location, names, and commodity tonnage summaries (total tons, domestic, foreign, imports and exports) for principal USACE ports for CY 2023.
meta.license: "This data set is publicly available without any use restrictions; however, this data set was developed for use at a national scale and may not be appropriate for use in local scale mapping." Requested credit: "Acknowledgment of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE)/Navigation and Civil Works Decision Support/Waterborne Commerce Statistics Center, and the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) [distributor]."
meta.notes: The source layer geometry is a POLYGON (port statistical area) per port. lat/lon are the polygon centroids computed by the ArcGIS server (returnCentroid=true, WGS84) and rounded to 6 decimals; they are representative points, not berth locations, and for large port areas can fall away from the docks. 'state'/'states' are parsed from the 2-letter codes in the source PORTNAME (state is null when the name lists several states or none). 'rank' is the source RANK: "Numerical rank denoting the top 150 ports in total tonnage". Tonnage units ('short tons') are from the NTAD data dictionary (ATTRUNIT). id = 'usace-' + source PORT code.
